title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard — WorkPass39
baseArchive: Neuro_Kurisu_WORKPASS38_2026-10-14.zip + canonical cognitive architecture, SHA-256 external evidence IDs, confidence-aware global workspace and upstream integration review
method: WorkPass39 adds actual emotion/feeling/interoceptive integration to the global cognitive workspace, fuses duplicate salience sources without evidence loss, prevents stale broadcasts from affecting actions when the network is disabled, and makes new external evidence IDs SHA-256 while preserving historical IDs. The canonical brain map stays read-only. Runtime suite and independent subsystem audits pass; Vite build remains blocked by outbound DNS, and retrieval candidate is not promoted because recallDelta=0.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: Single writable organism state/memory authorities preserved. WorkPass39 adds a read-only cognitive ownership map and typed flow validation without parallel runtime state.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: Runtime API and Runtime Atlas now surface the brain map and live composed-system health; routes and focused UI linkage are wired. Dependency-installed React/Vite and interactive browser Live2D E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: MemoryOS2 stays canonical; retrieval remains at BM25 parity on the current synthetic temporal fixture and is not promoted. Independent labelled holdout and genuine local embedding inference remain open.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: Durable ActionGateway receipts from WorkPass38 remain integrated. WorkPass39 strengthens attributable external evidence IDs and confidence-aware attention; actual provider/device reconciliation and reconnect/replay evidence remain open.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Cognitive map now ties self-model, affect/homeostasis, goals, perception, social cognition, memory, executive, reafference and metacognition to existing owners. This is architectural/system integration, not a claim of subjective consciousness.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Stable IDs for new evidence and legacy ID continuity are improved; external transport delivery receipts/reconnect and multi-provider reconciliation remain open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: Fifteen upstream projects/docs were reviewed; design patterns and licensing/status risks documented. No external code downloads claimed due unavailable container Git/DNS; direct upstream code review/port remains pending.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Release metadata and runtime gates aligned. Installed Vite build, browser E2E, clean-room restore/rollback, soak, SBOM and final release sign-off remain open.
